title: Grayt Joy
meta_description: Find the perfect Grayton Beach, FL vacation rental at “Grayt Joy”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 11 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Rooftop Deck with Gulf Views & Elevator. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Sweeping Panoramic Gulf Views -Private Pool - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 -Quiet Neighborhood of Gulf Trace -Brand New Construction -Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park -Community Beach Access -6 Adult Bikes Included Just five-minutes from the water where other vacationers are few, GRAYT JOY awaits you offering the captivating allure of panoramic Gulf views with gorgeous hues of emerald-green and azure water and the sound of hypnotic waves washing over the sun toasted sands. Here, a sense of peaceful, indulgent vacation calls to the beach lover in all of us. No detail has been overlooked in this jaw-dropping modern beach cottage spanning a vertical footprint of three levels with its exclusive sun-drenched observation deck on the fourth. You will find the perfect outside entertainment space featuring a private pool framed by a gorgeous patio ideal for sunbathing and grilling fresh seafood straight from the coast. Inside, jaw-dropping luxury details include floor to ceiling windows framing those exclusive water views, natural wide plank flooring, vaulted tongue and groove ceilings, custom lighting, and a private elevator, among so many others. The first and second levels invite guests to find respite in private sleeping spaces thoughtfully designed for retreat and relaxation. On the first level there is a quintessential bunkroom with a twin over queen bunk featuring a private ensuite with spa shower. The second level boasts four decadent king suites each with its own custom designed feature wall, sunlight pouring in floor to ceiling windows with coveted views, and an ensuite including luscious spa showers, pristine tile work, and sumptuous, modern vanities tailored to each space. The third floor is home to the breathtaking main living space with natural light bathing the airy, modern open floor plan. The focal point of the large living space is the modern electric fireplace framed with open shelving, curated coastal décor, plush comfortable furnishings, and custom chandeliers overhead. Pristine, neutral colors are grounded by the warm natural wood accents of the floor and ceiling throughout the entire space. Luxury appliances in the chef’s kitchen create a custom look with their built-in fit, sleek lines, and robust details. A custom hood tops the 6-burner gas cooktop and professional grade appliances make for easy and fun meal prep. Custom cabinetry offers spacious storage, and the kitchen island is a showpiece with its opulent white waterfall countertop, natural wood accents, and cleverly designed attached table with seating for four. Whether your plan is for casual dining or formal entertaining, the dining room with lovely views has seating for six under its gorgeous custom chandelier. The well-equipped bar is not only beautifully aesthetic; its mini-fridge and wine cooler provide perfectly chilled beverages for your favorite wine or cocktail creation. If coffee is your guilty morning pleasure, there is a specially designed nook nestled in the butler’s pantry just off the kitchen and dining areas just for you. Guests’ every need has been anticipated and intentionally woven into the design of this magnificent vacation home. There is a beautiful laundry space on the first level and ample driveway space for 6 cars. Please note that the garage space is reserved for owners and is not for guest use. GRAYT JOY will delight the coastal wanderer in all of us. First Floor Twin over Queen Bunk with Private Bath, Shower Only Second Floor King Bedroom - Private bath with Shower Only King Bedroom - Private Bath with Shower Tub Combo King Bedroom - Private Bath with Shower Only King Bedroom - Private Bath with Shower Only **Community does not allow for Golf Carts** **Fireplaces not for guest use**
